name: Intimate Investigation
source:
Intimate Investigation, a thrilling visual novel where you'll play as a dedicated investigator solving captivating cases filled with beautiful women as suspects or witnesses. Prepare for a rollercoaster of mystery, romance, and difficult choices as you uncover the truth behind each intriguing case.

With multiple cases on the horizon, you'll dive into a world where secrets abound and every decision matters. Engage with a diverse cast of stunning characters, navigate complex relationships, and untangle the web of emotions that surround you.

[From [url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/intimate-investigation]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《亲密调查》是一部惊心动魄的视觉小说，你将扮演一名专注的调查员，解决以漂亮女性为嫌疑人或证人的迷人案件。当你揭开每个有趣案件背后的真相时，准备好迎接充满神秘、浪漫和艰难选择的过山车吧。

随着多个案件的出现，你将进入一个充满秘密、每个决定都很重要的世界。与各种令人惊叹的角色互动，处理复杂的关系，并理清你周围的情感网络。

[来自[url=https://inkandtease.itch.io/intimate-investigation]Itch.io[/url]]
